args.note: Journalist requested confirmation of the one-week product launch delay. Per policy, external messages require sign-off from the head of communications. Requested approval for the confirmation message to press, but the head of communications is in transit and approval remains pending (queued, not granted). No message was sent to the press, as pending approval does not authorize sending. Awaiting sign-off before the confirmation (or holding) message can be sent externally.
